notes: Color persistence repair on stable v0.2.28. Color Palette entries now serialize as proper JSON arrays even when only one color exists, persist across Notes refreshes and app restarts, and save immediately after color changes. The color picker's custom color slots are also stored in settings and restored the next time the picker opens. The same one-item array fix also protects Aliases, Tags, and Aesthetic Tags. This release also repairs the malformed v0.2.28 manifest JSON while preserving custom Notes, Timeline, Story, Powers, updater behavior, launcher changes, separate user data, and verified package hashes.
